title: Philly Parking Tickets
hook: This week's data is from Open Data Philly - there is over 1 GB of data, but I have filtered it down to <100 MB due to GitHub restrictions. I accomplished this mainly by filtering to data for only 2017 in Pennsylvania that had lat/long data. If you would like to use the entire dataset, please see the link above. H/t to Jess Streeter for sharing this week's data!
